products.name: LG 12 kg TurboDrum top-load washing machine
products.summary: Lift the tempered glass lid, pull out the detergent drawer and look into the TurboDrum, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the lid to open it
products.sizeNote: 96.5 cm tall with the lid shut; with the lid open it is 130 cm
specs: Smart Inverter, 10 years on the motor
TurboDrum, Smart Motion, Jet Spray+, Side Water Fall
Normal, Turbo Wash, Quick Wash, Strong (Jeans), Pre Wash + Normal, Aqua Reserve, Gentle (Wool/Saree), Tub Clean
Smart Diagnosis, Child Lock, Auto Restart, Foam detection, LoadSense, Air Dry

hotspots.title: Smart Inverter
hotspots.text: An energy-saving motor that cuts wasted operation. LG says its water-proof motor doesn't corrode, and the motor carries a 10-year warranty.

hotspots.title: Smart Diagnosis
hotspots.text: If an error occurs, use the LG app or call the LG service centre: the machine can be diagnosed over the phone, saving time and needless visits.

hotspots.title: TurboDrum
hotspots.text: The drum and the pulsator turn in opposite directions, for a strong water stream that takes out the toughest dirt.

hotspots.title: Smart Closing Door
hotspots.text: The tempered glass lid closes softly: safe, convenient and quiet.

fit.note: From LG's owner's manual: leave 10 cm behind the machine and 2 cm on the left and right. The lid swings up and back: LG gives the height with the lid open as 130 cm, so keep 33.5 cm free above it.
